texts.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently developed new technologies, and their industry has started to grow at a frantic pace. Factories, smelters, assembly lines, and fuel extractors have been built across the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] as partial automation has found its way into the mind of the local hive. Dark smoke streaks the skies, and many drones are starting to show signs of degeneration due to the toxic chemicals they are in contact with. Soon the hive will have to address these issues, yet the unfazed drones keep working as usual.

# 工业之火 / The Fires of Industry

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:5265-5433`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100.
- 条件：格式塔文明处于工业时代，以被动观察、样本采集或游牧中继站观测；每个前超光速文明一次；延迟 5–30 天。
  Conditions: a gestalt civilization in the Industrial Age, observed with Passive Observation, Specimen Collection or a nomad waystation; once per pre-FTL civilization; 5-30-day delay.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2525「工业之火」：蜂巢的工业以疯狂的速度扩张。
  2525 "The Fires of Industry": the hive's industry expands at a frantic pace.
- 观测者按类型的评论选项（普通帝国中环保主义者措辞不同），或“迷人”。单页事件。
  A comment option by observer type (environmentalist regular empires get different wording), or "Fascinating". A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与选项条件。
  Checked: trigger and option conditions.
